page.layout: One page: a digitiser's cover sheet. Top right the e-rara logo; centred title block (website, title, author, place and year, library, shelf mark, persistent link); below a rule, a multilingual description of the platform and terms of use in small type, with the Visual Library logo bottom right. All of it is digitiser's material, not printed text of the book.
